key_difference: (D) adds a separate decodeForLocalFile() that decodes percent-encoded UTF-8 sequences. (B) instead adds the checks to the existing decode() and relies on the QUrl invariant that valid UTF-8 is already stored decoded, so it rejects every byte >= 0x80; (D) also omits (B)'s Windows pre-check for literal backslashes that are stored in decoded form, so such paths pass unchecked on Windows.
